strings.zh: 马志士『哦,耶！{NEWLINE}你的精灵不就是{CLEAR}我最喜欢的皮卡丘吗~！{SCROLL}太棒了！{SCROLL}就把我的电话号码告诉你吧！{CLEAR}你当然想知道吧？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Lt. Surge: Oh, yay! You have the{NEWLINE}Pokémon I love best: Pikachu!{SCROLL}Excellent! I’ll give{NEWLINE}you my telephone number!{CLEAR}Of course you want it, right?{VAR:0200:0}
strings.notes: US 0341/0; modernised from US 0341#0 | RV012: omission: 你当然想知道吧 (yes/no question) restored; layout rebalance 2026-10-09 (prompt icons / single-word page)

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}把马志士{NEWLINE}登录到了手机中！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0} registered Lt. Surge{NEWLINE}in the Pokégear!

strings.zh: 马志士『星期五的{NEWLINE}早上打电话给我！{SCROLL}和我来场{NEWLINE}麻酥酥的对战吧！
strings.en: Lt. Surge: Give me a call on Friday{NEWLINE}morning!{SCROLL}We can have an electrifying battle!

strings.zh: 马志士『哦,不！{NEWLINE}我太~遗憾了。
strings.en: Lt. Surge: Oh no!{NEWLINE}How disappointing!

strings.zh: 马志士『果然不出所料？{NEWLINE}想知道我的{CLEAR}电话号码了吧？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Lt. Surge: Aha!{NEWLINE}Now you want to know my telephone{CLEAR}number, don’t you? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 马志士『哦~！在这里{NEWLINE}再会真是奇遇啊！{SCROLL}电站的附近能感觉到{CLEAR}麻酥酥的电能呢~！{SCROLL}要在常磐森林{NEWLINE}抓到皮卡丘的话,{CLEAR}带到这里来就好了！
strings.en: Lt. Surge: Oh! What are the chances{NEWLINE}of seeing you at a place like this?{SCROLL}I can feel electric power around{NEWLINE}the Power Plant.{SCROLL}You may want to catch a Pikachu in{NEWLINE}the Viridian Forest and bring it here!

strings.zh: 大型精灵{NEWLINE}一动不动地注视着……！{SCROLL}
strings.en: There is a large Pokémon staring{NEWLINE}at you...!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 雷精灵『噼噜噼噜噼嚓！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Jolteon: Piru-piru-picha!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: D-1195: reverted to match the zh (The Power Plant legendary’s cry is labelled 雷精灵 (Jolteon) with the cry 噼噜噼噜噼嚓); logged in hack_findings_import.jsonl

strings.zh: 此发电所因污染问题,无限期关停
strings.en: This power plant is closed indefinitely{NEWLINE}due to pollution.

strings.zh: 这里是岩山隧道
strings.en: Rock Tunnel

strings.zh: 现在岩山隧道里有考古专家{NEWLINE}正在进行严肃的考古工作,{CLEAR}请等考古工作结束后再进入隧道。{SCROLL}您如果觉得在这里等着太无聊的话,{NEWLINE}可以先去华蓝的海角啊、{CLEAR}枯叶的码头啊{CLEAR}这些有名的景点转转。
strings.en: Archaeologists are doing serious{NEWLINE}excavation work in Rock Tunnel.{SCROLL}Please wait until their work is finished{NEWLINE}before entering the tunnel.{SCROLL}If waiting here bores you, why not visit{NEWLINE}some famous sights first, like Cerulean{CLEAR}Cape or Vermilion Harbor?

strings.zh: 大甲,使用碎岩！
strings.en: Pinsir, use Rock Smash!

strings.zh: 我在让大甲练习着{NEWLINE}用碎岩斩断小树,{CLEAR}目前不是很成功。{CLEAR}看来想要斩断路中间的小树,{CLEAR}必须得使用「居合斩」这个技能才行,{CLEAR}据说枯叶市有一位游轮的船长,{CLEAR}他就有「居合斩」的技能机。
strings.en: I’m having Pinsir practice cutting down{NEWLINE}small trees with Rock Smash. It’s not{CLEAR}going very well so far.{SCROLL}Looks like you really need the move Cut{NEWLINE}to clear the small trees in the road.{SCROLL}I hear a cruise ship captain in Vermilion{NEWLINE}City has the HM for Cut.
strings.notes: 技能机 here is HM01: script 191 checks HasItem 420 (HM01) right after this line (D-0585, cf. D-0690).

strings.zh: 什么？你已经拿到了？{SCROLL}你可真是厉害！
strings.en: What? You already have it?{SCROLL}You’re really something!

strings.zh: 大甲『Pin——si！
strings.en: Pinsir: Pin-si!

strings.zh: 金属怪『Me——tangtang！
strings.en: Metang: Me-tangtang!

strings.zh: 大吾『{VAR:0103:0}也打算{NEWLINE}到岩山洞穴冒险吗？{CLEAR}我本来打算进岩山洞穴研究一下{CLEAR}关于三神柱的古代传说的。{CLEAR}不过现在好像有专家在里面研究这个,{CLEAR}看来得等他们工作完了,{CLEAR}我才有机会进去一探究竟。
strings.en: Steven: {VAR:0103:0}, are you planning to{NEWLINE}explore Rock Tunnel too?{SCROLL}I meant to go in and research an old{NEWLINE}legend about the three God Pillars.{SCROLL}But it seems some experts are already{NEWLINE}studying it in there.{SCROLL}I guess I’ll have to wait until they{NEWLINE}finish before I can take a look.
strings.notes: 三神柱 = the three God Pillars (old zh name for the Regis; 神柱 → God Pillars as in 0464).

strings.zh: 真稀奇啊,{NEWLINE}除了我之外还会有人到这里来。{CLEAR}你也是来做生态调查的吗？
strings.en: How unusual. Someone besides me came{NEWLINE}out here.{SCROLL}Are you here for an ecological survey{NEWLINE}too?

strings.zh: 生态调查？
strings.en: An ecological survey?

strings.zh: 我就是来闲逛的……
strings.en: I’m just wandering around...

strings.zh: 保护环境人人有责,{NEWLINE}请你也一起尽一份力吧。
strings.en: Protecting the environment is{NEWLINE}everyone’s job.{SCROLL}Please do your part too.

strings.zh: 这里原来是那个常磐市馆主{NEWLINE}名下的私人发电所,{CLEAR}后来因污染而被精灵联盟关停。{CLEAR}不过依现在的情况来看,{CLEAR}这里已经完全看不到污染的痕迹了。{SCROLL}根据我的调查发现,{NEWLINE}是臭泥们以污染物为食{CLEAR}将这里的环境给净化了。{SCROLL}很神奇吧？明明看起来脏兮兮的、{NEWLINE}大家都不怎么喜欢的口袋妖怪{CLEAR}却可以净化环境。
strings.en: This used to be a private power plant{NEWLINE}owned by that Viridian City Gym Leader.{SCROLL}It was later shut down by the{NEWLINE}Pokémon League because of pollution.{SCROLL}But from the look of things now,{NEWLINE}there’s no trace of pollution left here{CLEAR}at all.{SCROLL}According to my survey, the Grimer ate{NEWLINE}the pollutants and cleaned up the{CLEAR}environment here.{SCROLL}Amazing, right? Pokémon that look{NEWLINE}dirty, that nobody much likes, can{CLEAR}actually purify the environment.

strings.zh: 臭臭泥『Muuu——uuuk！
strings.en: Muk: Muuu-uuuk!

strings.zh: 保护环境人人有责,{NEWLINE}切不可因为一时的贪念{CLEAR}而破坏我们赖以生存的家园。
strings.en: Protecting the environment is{NEWLINE}everyone’s job.{SCROLL}Never let a moment of greed destroy{NEWLINE}the home we all depend on.
